name: @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-stages
description: DSH plugin that brings tavern-design, tavern-cards, and tavern-ui workflows into dsh-stage-switch stages
//dependencies-note: All @ai4rpg dependencies except tavern-agents resolve from npm as plain versioned deps. @ai4rpg/dsh-stage-switch ^0.2.0 is the stage machine this plugin extends (0.2.0 reads session stage records through the session-projection seam and carries the `language` row config; its required peer @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection is composed by dsh-base, so deployments satisfy it without listing it here). @ai4rpg/tavern-cards-forge ^0.1.0 ships the forge CLI (dist/index.mjs) that the tavern_forge tool runs. @ai4rpg/tavern-agents carries the named-subagent personas (CC BY-NC-SA, so they do not ship in this MIT package) and is deliberately NOT a dependency of this package: this package publishes to npm, and a published manifest must not carry file: specs. The personas reach the profile through the tavern content repo instead: @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset depends on @ai4rpg/tavern-agents via a file:../tavern-agents spec that stays inside that self-contained repo, pnpm hoists the content package into the profile's node_modules, and resolveAgentsDir() finds it from here with createRequire. TAVERN_AGENTS_ROOT overrides the resolution for tests, and the real-package tests skip when the package is unresolvable: this repo deliberately carries no file: devDependency, so a fresh clone resolves nothing; install the content package from a local checkout without saving it (npm i --no-save <tavern-content>/tavern-agents) to re-enable them. stage-switch rides as a real dependency (not a peer) because dsh-base does not provide it: downstream deployments resolve it from this package's install, and autoInstallPeers is false in DSH profiles.
